Source inspection and the fresh focused run confirm a required root officeDocument relationship, one direct canonical sheets list, qualified relationship attributes, unique explicit lexical identities/names/targets, worksheet Type and root checks, and no inferred sheetN.xml fallback. Valid tested workbook ordering, Japanese names, strict namespaces, hidden state, exact decimal lexemes and saved formula zero with not-recalculated metadata are preserved. This check covers those demonstrated cases only; URI-target rejection has the blocking counterexample below.

Independent synthetic test test_absolute_url_cannot_bind_even_if_zip_has_posix_lookalike fails because ValueError is not raised. A worksheet Relationship with Target=https://invalid.example/worksheet.xml and no TargetMode resolves to the ZIP member xl/https:/invalid.example/worksheet.xml when that member exists with a canonical worksheet root. _resolve_ooxml_target at parser lines 645-664 uses posixpath joining/normalization without excluding a URI scheme; _xlsx_sheet_context then accepts the crafted part. The permanent unsafe-URL test lacks the lookalike member and therefore tests absence rather than URI rejection. Reproduction is design/local-memory-v1-hardening/runs/f10-adversarial-cases.v1.py:20; bounded failure log is artifacts/local-memory-v1-hardening/runs/f10-audit-adversarial-v1/unittest.log, SHA-256 debe98aee7b3d02f1ea273ccb0896e39626163ec5d6a6388041481280c27c9da. No network request was made; the defect is forged source binding.
checks.required_action: Reject non-package URI targets before POSIX member resolution, including a supplied absolute URI even when a matching lookalike ZIP member exists. Add a permanent regression with that member present, check no Evidence/Relation emission, preserve valid internal relative and absolute package targets, then rerun the scoped suites and submit a new hashed artifact.

checks.reason: Independent synthetic test test_late_missing_direct_sheet_data_leaves_no_reader_evidence raises the expected ValueError for a second canonical worksheet whose sheetData is nested inside extension, but then fails the permanent helper's reader.evidence == [] contract: two first-sheet Evidence records remain. _xlsx_sheet_context validates worksheet roots before projection, while direct sheetData validation at parser lines 4126-4130 occurs inside the emitting loop after earlier sheets have emitted records. The permanent direct-rejection helper explicitly requires empty Evidence/Relation sinks and already applies that contract to sheetData errors, but tests only a single invalid sheet. Probe.extract has no rollback in its finally block. The build process_file layer has a separate discard_uncommitted_records boundary, so this finding is about the direct Reader atomicity claim and does not allege persisted shard leakage. The second adversarial failure is in the same preserved 2-test log; there are zero skips/errors.
checks.required_action: Validate every referenced worksheet's required direct sheetData structure before emitting any workbook Evidence/Relation, or provide an equivalent direct-Reader transaction boundary. Add a multi-sheet permanent rejection test with a valid first sheet and a malformed later sheet, retain downstream failed-document rollback coverage, and rerun the audit without weakening the empty-sink assertion.

checks.reason: The focused integration method freshly passes through the real intermediate builder, both intermediate validators, search builder, both search validators and adapter. Its five covered rejected XLSX files publish failed Documents with zero Evidence/Relation/SearchUnit/adapter Evidence; the good workbook remains partial and the text neighbor successful. All seven synthetic source hashes remain unchanged. Source inspection confirms process_file discards uncommitted records on extraction exceptions. This does not establish rejection or rollback for the URI target that currently causes no exception, nor does it repair direct Reader leakage.

The decision is revise for this F10 binding repair only. Cell payload namespaces, sharedStrings/styles/defined names, full cell-coordinate/schema semantics, all OPC/OOXML formats, native openpyxl, large resources, real models, safe SQLite/index/answer, packaging and whole-product acceptance remain outside this audit. No test count is used as proof of universal support. The two concrete contract failures require repair before scoped acceptance.
